title: Lesson 6: Hiring, Onboarding, and Running a Team of Consultants
description: The principal hires for the delivery system, not for a role they used to fill. How to staff against a captured method, onboard people onto it with a measurable exit gate, and run a team so quality stays a property of the system instead of a bet on any single person.
